form.consent: I agree to Saathi recording my voice and documents to help fill my savings account form.
form.full_name.label: Full name
form.dob.label: Date of birth
form.dob.prompt: What is your date of birth? Please say the day, month and year.
form.mobile.label: Mobile number
form.address.label: Address
form.occupation.label: Occupation
form.occupation.prompt: What is your occupation? For example retired, homemaker, farmer, business or salaried.
form.nominee_name.label: Nominee name
form.nominee_name.prompt: Who should be the nominee for this account? Please tell me their full name.
form.nominee_relation.label: Nominee relation
form.nominee_relation.prompt: How is the nominee related to you? For example spouse, son or daughter.
form.notify_consent.label: WhatsApp updates
form.notify_consent.prompt: May we send you updates about your application on WhatsApp? Please say yes or no.
engine.retry: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Please say it again.
engine.busy: The assistant is busy right now. Please type your answer in English letters, or try again in a minute.
mismatch.NAME_SPELLED_DIFFERENTLY: Your name on the {doc} is spelled a little differently. Please choose the correct spelling.
mismatch.NAME_MISMATCH: The name on the {doc} does not match the name you told us. Please check.
mismatch.DOB_MISMATCH: The date of birth on the {doc} does not match what you told us.
mismatch.AADHAAR_INVALID: The Aadhaar number could not be verified. Please take a clearer photo or check the card.
mismatch.PAN_INVALID: The PAN number looks wrong. Please check the card or take a clearer photo.
mismatch.IFSC_INVALID: The bank IFSC code on the passbook looks wrong. Please take a clearer photo of the first page.
mismatch.PHOTO_BLURRY: The photo of the {doc} is blurry. Please take it again in good light.
